fonts: production Noto TTF; rasterizer differs from LVGL

screens.title: Numeric
screens.note: Normal view; no routine status sentence or brand footer.

screens.title: Arc
screens.note: Normal view; no routine status sentence or brand footer.

screens.title: Bar
screens.note: Normal view; no routine status sentence or brand footer.

screens.title: Trend
screens.note: Normal view; no routine status sentence or brand footer.

screens.title: Dual
screens.note: Normal view; no routine status sentence or brand footer.

screens.title: Dual + engine warning
screens.note: Unboxed engine icon higher on the display, with a small count for multiple known codes; code text stays in inspection.

screens.title: Stored codes, lamp off
screens.note: Muted wrench distinguishes recorded codes from a lit warning lamp.

screens.title: MIL on, count unknown
screens.note: An unknown count never becomes zero or a false all-clear.

screens.changeSummary: Raised the reading block by 12 px to balance the warning below when no CEL is shown.
screens.title: Warning threshold
screens.note: Reading first; one compact warning condition below. The lower alert row replaces page dots.

screens.title: Threshold + MIL
screens.note: CEL and fault count stay at the top; Coolant warning stays below both readings, including when its PID is on another page.

screens.title: Critical attention
screens.note: One takeover: condition, value, limit and acknowledgment. No background labels bleed through.

screens.changeSummary: Raised the reading block by 12 px; the retained critical condition stays below.
screens.title: Acknowledged critical
screens.note: Acknowledgment returns readings; the active critical condition stays red in the lower row and is not cleared.

screens.title: Fault inspection
screens.note: Proposed optional status tap; one code at a time with controller and category, swipes move codes.

screens.changeSummary: Raised the live reading by 12 px; retained unavailable-source context stays below.
screens.title: Warning source unavailable
screens.note: ATF warning input is missing while RPM remains live. Its retained last-seen condition stays below the reading.

screens.title: Diagnostic coverage unknown
screens.note: Proposed neutral coverage state, with no green healthy claim.

screens.title: Missing ECM source
screens.note: Each row expires independently; the other reading remains usable.

screens.title: Missing TCM source
screens.note: Each row expires independently; the other reading remains usable.

screens.title: Reading unavailable
screens.note: Dashes indicate absent, invalid or stale input. Arc/bar become inactive; trend shows a gap.

screens.title: Five-digit value
screens.note: 48 px value fits completely; no clipping, scrolling or automatic digit truncation.

screens.title: Custom decimal PID
screens.note: Metadata selects precision and unit; font selection uses measured glyph bounds.

screens.title: Custom numeric + enum
screens.note: Bounded enum strings and numeric formats use the same row component.

screens.title: Negative and fractional
screens.note: Sign and decimal precision remain intact.

screens.title: Simulated data
screens.note: Deliberate bench/demo source, with a small Demo footer and no simulation pill. Missing vehicle data never becomes demo data.

screens.title: Pairing ready
screens.note: One instruction; identifying suffix retained for selecting the right gauge.

screens.title: Pairing window closed
screens.note: Existing hold gesture remains; no engineering owner-state sentence.

screens.title: Passkey entry
screens.note: Six digits fit at 48 px, grouped for readability; ID occupies a separate row.

screens.title: Pairing success
screens.note: Brief confirmation then automatic return; Done is optional, not required.

screens.title: Owner reset confirmation
screens.note: Review deliberate reset separately; explicit target, timeout/cancel behavior retained.

screens.title: Update maintenance
screens.note: Proposed maintenance view only while an actual update is active, not for routine phone reads.

screens.title: Post-update confirmation
screens.note: Transfer and healthy activation stay separate; automatic return after verification.

screens.title: Actionable update pause
screens.note: Concise next action; technical failure remains in the App.

screens.title: Empty dashboard
screens.note: Only for an actual empty dashboard, never an adapter disconnect.

screens.title: Page shortcut progress
screens.note: Temporary progress uses the status lane only when no higher-priority state owns it.

screens.title: Shortcut complete
screens.note: Brief feedback returns to the shared lane; it cannot cover a fault.

screens.title: Critical input lost
screens.note: Severity remains active; last observed value is labelled and never presented as fresh.

screens.title: Future phone/provider alert
screens.note: Countdown arc illustrates 20 of 30 seconds remaining and drains toward expiry. No Paired phone or Expires in text. Source details stay in App context; local critical alerts retain priority.

screens.title: Update not applied
screens.note: Proposed actionable rollback outcome; retained pages are restored when the outcome is known.

screens.changeSummary: Raised the reading block by 12 px; warning and quiet Demo footer stay separate.
screens.title: Warning + simulation
screens.note: Generated bench values remain labelled Demo below the alert row. Missing vehicle data never enables demo input.

screens.title: Critical + simulation
screens.note: Deliberate demo data remains identified by the small Demo footer; there is no pill or extra attention text.

screens.title: Numeric + CEL + alert
screens.note: Fixed top CEL/count and lower condition. Charts and units keep dedicated space; no alert-time reflow.

screens.title: Arc + CEL + alert
screens.note: Fixed top CEL/count and lower condition. Charts and units keep dedicated space; no alert-time reflow.

screens.title: Bar + CEL + alert
screens.note: Fixed top CEL/count and lower condition. Charts and units keep dedicated space; no alert-time reflow.

screens.title: Trend + CEL + alert
screens.note: Fixed top CEL/count and lower condition. Charts and units keep dedicated space; no alert-time reflow.

screens.title: Custom decimal + alert
screens.note: Full decimal value and converted unit remain readable; authored short alert alias is bounded independently.

screens.title: Dual units + alert
screens.note: Units appear once beside their value; the condition stays below both rows.

screens.title: Long enum + alert
screens.note: The complete enum keeps its 40 px fit; the lower condition never truncates its digits or label.

screens.title: Multiple alerts + CEL
screens.note: Top 4 counts fault entries. Lower +2 means two additional active alerts. The highest-priority condition stays stable; tap opens inspection, never timed text cycling.

screens.title: Acknowledged critical + CEL
screens.note: After explicit acknowledgment, CEL remains above and active critical condition below. New critical entry/escalation still uses the full attention screen.

screens.title: Below threshold + unknown CEL count
screens.note: Down arrow identifies a low condition; the top question mark keeps unknown fault coverage explicit.

screens.title: Lost TCM + retained alert
screens.note: Missing gear becomes dashes, sibling RPM stays live and the prior ATF warning remains explicitly last seen.

screens.title: Both sources absent + retained alert
screens.note: Both readings are unavailable. Retained attention is not a fresh sample; unknown CEL count is not zero.
